entries.title: Dropdowns open and paste works in a task's browser
entries.body: When you take control of a task's browser, a click on a dropdown now opens its list on the page, and you can pick an option. The list is drawn inside the page, so dropdowns can look a little different from other browsers. Pasting (⌘V on a Mac, Ctrl+V on Linux) now puts in the words you copied on your own computer, even when the task runs on another computer, and the other editing keys work from a Linux computer too.

picture.alt: A task's browser under your control with a page's dropdown list open, showing its options
